description: Monthly traction energy consumption (total) is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Infrabel. Total tractie-energieverbruik per maand in MWh sinds 1987. Producenten maken elektriciteit in centrales. Deze elektriciteit wordt op een hoge wisselspanning getransporteerd en bereikt zo de tractieonderstations van Infrabel. Deze onderstations zetten de spanning om en verdelen deze via de bovenleiding. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Energy. Its keywords are Energie, Tractie, Tractieonderstations. The portal shows 480 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-07-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
